purpose: Protect study outputs against inflated audience totals from overlapping niche interests, multi-account behavior and heterogeneous source populations.

symbol_definitions.N: Count of distinct eligible people in one declared common frame (if measured)
symbol_definitions.A_i: Count of distinct people reporting membership in one category i in that frame
symbol_definitions.O_ij: Deduplicated count of people in both categories i and j, from the same matched sample

formal_method.two_group_formula: |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|, but only with directly validated joint-membership overlap
formal_method.without_overlap_bounds: max(|A_i|) ≤ |union(A_i)| ≤ min(N, sum(|A_i|)) when all counts refer to the same unique-person frame
formal_method.more_than_two_groups: Pairwise overlaps alone do not establish a unique combined count because triple and higher intersections remain unknown.
formal_method.method: A joint respondent-level survey with consent, a matched and deduplicated person-level panel, or a legitimately obtained aggregate joint-frequency table with identical units and survey population is required for exact union.
formal_method.cannot_apply_to: Views, impressions, subscribers, channels, advertisements served, search events, language groups, overlapping country/platform samples, or differing survey frames without validated reconciliation.

source_bounded_examples.scope: U.S. adult self-reported platform use, not niche membership
source_bounded_examples.valid_use: Illustrate the need for explicit U.S. adult denominator, age and period.
source_bounded_examples.cannot_supply: A joint beauty-gaming niche overlap count

source_bounded_examples.scope: U.S. survey responses for news-on-YouTube behavior
source_bounded_examples.valid_use: Observe an explicitly news-specific audience construct.
Illustrate that ad reach is not unique people or a deduplicated multi-niche census.
source_bounded_examples.cannot_supply: A Mexican union of creator-interest community audiences

publication_gates.reason: No matched, deduplicated joint frame across the five example topic groupings is collected.
Public view, impression and channel counts may not be substituted for survey respondents.
Overlap counts or full cross-tabulations are not yet available.
Response/weighting and group inclusion questions are unmeasured for cross-topic joint membership.

privacy_policy: Do not infer ethnicity, religion, gender identity or political affiliation from individual viewing history, names, comments, or faces.
Do not publish respondent-level observations, account tokens or identifying cross-platform matching keys.
Only use aggregation compatible with audience source permissions and informed consent where required.
Separate children and teenagers from adult surveys; do not profile individual minors.
Keep the union unknown when denominators, population frames or deduplication are missing.
